title: Recovery, delivery leases and journal model
summary: W registers a watch, E commits a rising edge, S commits its falling-edge rearm, K grants a bounded owner lease, R confirms receipt, C confirms completion. Replay restores the latest per-watch edge and per-event delivery state; a claimed event becomes available when its lease expires.
invariants: A plain seenWatch flag cannot support durable re-arming; the S record is required.
Never mark completion before a valid claim and receipt.
One browser session at a time holds a lease, but crash-after-side-effect does not provide exactly-once delivery.
This development journal does not guarantee fsync or torn-write repair; production storage must use a qualified durable store with transaction/checksum controls.

provenance.claim: Development source candidate; qualification state explicitly bounded.
